title: Genderpoly
subtitle: One career. Another turn.
introduction: Congratulations! You've been shortlisted for a position at FreeDom, a creative production company that makes advertising, branded content and TV, where fresh ideas and bold thinking are always welcome. Your interview is tomorrow. Are you ready to take the first step towards your dream career?
promotionTitle: Chapter 4: The Other Side of the Table
promotionText:
A few more years have passed. You're now the company's Creative Director. Your office is at the end of the corridor, with a door that closes. Now you're the one asking people out for coffee and deciding whose names go on the list.                 

You remember what it felt like to sit on the other side. But from this side, a lot of things don't look so simple.
